text_block_list.text: Summer training camp, the final day—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(...Yep, all good.
I haven't forgotten anything.)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
It was only for a short time,
but thank you so much for taking care of me~...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ("Summer training camp is over!" ...And with that!)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(M-My yukata photo
is going a bit viral...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so,
this year's summer training camp drew to a close.
